---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new diagnostic capability
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem / Use case

What problem does this solve, and who benefits from it?

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Safety / Write-policy considerations

- Does this require a new register or RPC?
- Does it affect write tiers, grants, approvals, keepalive behavior, or verification?
- Is there a read-only or demo-mode way to validate it before any real-bike use?
